sources.name: Duale, Ovia & Alex-Adedipe: KYC Requirements for Onboarding New Customers by Fintech Companies in Nigeria
CBN Circular FPR/DIR/CIR/GEN/02/001: Introduction of Three-Tiered Know Your Customer Requirements
CBN Circular PSP/DIR/PUB/CIR/001/002: Addendum to the Revised Regulatory Framework for Bank Verification Number Operations and Watch-List

entries.subject: bvn_definition
entries.value_text: A number that gives a bank customer a single identity across the banking system
entries.display: The BVN is a number that enables a bank customer to have a single identity in the banking system
entries.quote: The BVN is a number that enables a bank customer to have a single identity in the banking system.
entries.notes: CBN page describes the scheme launched with the Bankers' Committee on 14 February 2014.

entries.subject: bvn_launch
entries.value_text: centralised biometric identification system for the banking industry
entries.display: BVN was launched as a centralised biometric identification system for the banking industry
entries.quote: launched a centralized biometric identification system for the banking industry, tagged Bank verification Number (BVN)

entries.subject: bvn_transaction_threshold
entries.display: Transactions of N100,000,000 and above were only allowed for customers with a BVN from March 2015
entries.quote: Transactions valued at N100,000,000.00 (One hundred million Naira) and above should only be allowed for customers with BVN by March 2015
entries.notes: Date line is the circular requirement date quoted on the CBN page.

entries.subject: kyc_compliance_without_bvn
entries.display: A customer without a BVN by 31 October 2015 is deemed not to have met KYC requirements
entries.quote: without BVN by October 31, 2015 would be deemed not to have met Know Your Customer (KYC) requirements

entries.subject: tier1_identification_documents
entries.value_text: passport photograph; name, place and date of birth; gender, address, telephone number
entries.display: Level 1 requires basic customer information: passport photograph, name, place and date of birth, gender, address, telephone number
entries.quote: Basic customer information required to be provided are: - Passport photograph; - Name, place and date of birth; - Gender, address, telephone number, etc.

entries.subject: tier1_verification
entries.display: Level 1 requires no verification of the information supplied
entries.quote: Evidence of information provided by customer or verification of same is not required.

entries.subject: tier1_account_type
entries.display: Level 1 accounts are strictly savings accounts

entries.subject: tier2_verification_database
entries.display: Level 2 customer information must be verified against official databases such as NIMC, INEC and FRSC
entries.quote: Fintech companies must verify basic information and identification of the customer against similar information contained in official databases such as the National Identity Management Commission, Independent Electoral Commission, and Federal Road Safety Commission.
entries.notes: The CBN three-tiered KYC circular requires the same cross-check against NIMC, INEC and FRSC databases, but its two-column table OCRs out of order, so the clean restatement is quoted.

entries.subject: tier3_account_opening_channel
entries.value_text: bank branch, physical presence of customer
entries.display: Level 3 accounts must be opened at a bank branch with the customer physically present
entries.quote: Account is to be opened at the bank branches by physical presence of the prospective customer.

entries.subject: bvn_minimum_age
entries.display: BVN enrolment is restricted to persons aged 18 and above
entries.quote: Enrolment for BVN is restricted to individuals who have attained the age of eighteen (18) years and above.
entries.notes: Corroborated by the Candide-Johnson note on the 2026 Guide, which states only individuals aged 18 can independently register a BVN.

entries.subject: bvn_phone_number_amendment
entries.display: The phone number linked to a BVN may be amended only once
entries.quote: Amendments to phone numbers linked to a BVN shall be allowed only once.
entries.notes: Corroborated by the Candide-Johnson note on the 2026 Guide (customers may change the BVN-linked phone number once in their lifetime).

entries.subject: bvn_data_access
entries.display: Access to BVN databases is granted exclusively to CBN-licensed financial institutions
entries.quote: Access to the BVN databases shall be exclusively granted to Central Bank of Nigeria (CBN) licensed financial institutions.

entries.subject: tiered_kyc_applies_to
entries.display: The three-tiered KYC regime applies to individuals only
entries.quote: the three-tiered KYC requirements apply to individuals only
entries.notes: enum: individuals; corporate accounts fall outside the tiered regime.

notes: The NIN-BVN linkage rule is NOT recorded: no document in this corpus states it, and it is not invented here. Tier 2 caps are quoted from the clean secondary restatement because the circular's table OCR interleaves columns.
